math_notes.text: The page abandons two disjointness/compatibility drafts and their corollaries, then proposes a locality criterion for compatibility under refinement. A marginal note explicitly says the criterion is false in the simplicial case and gives a drawing. The final named axiom and corollaries reuse the restriction indices L after introducing K.

The final contradiction in the upper NB is valid under the stated local assumptions that Z is a nonempty stratum, Z≪L and Z is disjoint from L. Disjointness gives compatibility and Z∩L=empty. By At4, applied to the stratum Z itself, Z≪L yields a stratum U≤L with Z≪U. Compatibility of Z with L descends to U, so At5 for compatible strata gives Z≤U≤L. Hence Z∩L=Z, contradicting that a stratum is nonempty. This checks the final contradiction only; it does not prove the preceding Z≪X,Y⇒Z≪X∩Y step or resolve the possible primes.

The globally compatible ⇒ locally compatible direction follows if the subscript-L objects are subfigures of their parents. Indeed, if A≤F′ and B≤G′ and H is a common upper figure for compatible F′ and G′, then H is also an upper figure for A and B. This proves hereditary compatibility for those subfigures. A definition of F′_L is not established on this page, so the check is explicitly conditional on that subfigure property and does not prove the displayed equivalence or the final axiom.

math_notes.type: targeted counterexample to literal cancelled formula
math_notes.text: The literal cancelled Cor1 formula, with F≪F and C′≪G but conclusion F′∥G′, cannot be a universal theorem as written. In the two-element Boolean figure poset {empty,{a}}, take refinement=inclusion and all figures compatible. Set F=C=G=C′=empty and F′=G′={a}. The disjointness premise and the two written refinement premises hold, while F′∩G′={a}, so the conclusion fails. This diagnoses the missing/mismatched primed operands in an abandoned draft; no correction is inserted into its text.

The simplicial counterexample is transcribed and drawn, but the restriction notation and identities of the parts of the drawing are insufficiently specified within the pages read to certify it independently. No external GFVI pages cited by H were consulted. The final hash-like relation is a contour reading, not an independently proved negation interpretation.

The cancelled F≪F and C′≪G, the initial C and later C/G uncertainty, and live K with subsequent L indices are preserved. The oblique ancien is readable but its verbal attachment remains uncertain. No missing conclusion is supplied after the abandoned Alors.
